real_rag_answers.question: What is Form 8843 used for?
real_rag_answers.answer: Form 8843 is used by alien individuals to explain the basis of their claim that they can exclude days of presence in the United States for purposes of the substantial presence test because they were an exempt individual or unable to leave the United States due to a medical condition. [1]

General Instructions
Who Must File
If you are an alien individual (other than a foreign governmentrelated individual), you must file Form 8843 to explain the basis 


of your claim that you can exclude days of presence in the 
United States for purposes of the substantial presence test 
because you:
• Were an exempt individual, or
• Were unable to leave the United States because of a medical 
condition or medical problem. 
When and Where To File
If you are filing a 2025 Form 1040-NR, attach Form 8843 to it. 
Mail your tax return by the due date (including extensions) to the 
address shown in your tax return instructions.

real_rag_answers.question: What information does that form ask students to provide?
real_rag_answers.answer:
According to [1], Part III Students, Form 8843 asks students to provide the following information:

1. The name, address, and telephone number of the academic institution you attended during 2025 (line 9).
2. The name, address, and telephone number of the director of the academic or other specialized program you participated in during 2025 (line 10).
3. The type of U.S. visa (F, J, M, or Q) you held during 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024 (line 11).
4. If the type of visa you held during any of these years changed, attach a statement showing the new visa type and the date it was acquired (line 11).

According to [2], Part III—Students, Form 8843 also states that a student is an individual who is temporarily present in the United States under an “F,” “J,” “M,” or “Q” visa and who substantially complies with the requirements of the visa.
